description.text: Anhui Medical University is qualified by China Ministry of Education to offer fully English medium medical programs for international students, so the international students will have no language problems in class. Also, Anhui Medical University has 4000 clinical sites that help internship students master medical knowledge and skills; and will take internship at home countries or in China.Teaching Objectives Clinical Medicine (MBBS) is mainly to train the international students capacities of body structure and function in human beings, human behavior, and normal state of mind; Causes of common diseases and frequently-occurring diseases including mental illnesses, the impact of environmental, social, behavioral and psychological factors on the occurrence and development of diseases and the importance of disease prevention; Pathogenesis, clinical symptoms, diagnosis and preventive ways of common diseases and frequently-occurring diseases; Basic knowledge of pharmacology and clinical principles of rational drug use; Normal pregnancy and delivery, common obstetric emergency treatment, principles of prenatal and postnatal health care, and family planning; Health education and disease prevention, common diseases, disabilities, rehabilitation, hospice care, and general practice; Knowledge of clinical epidemiology; Basic patterns of development and spread of infectious diseases, and prevention of common infectious diseases. Main Courses Pathology-II, Pathophysiology, Regional Anatomy, Forensic Medicine, Pharmacology-I, Physical Diagnosis, Pharmacology-II, Introductory Surgery, Dermatology, Medicine-I, Medicine-II, Infectious Diseases, Surgery-I, Paediatrics-I, Obstetrics & Gynaecology-I,-I Medicine-III,I Surgery-II, Paediatrics-II, Obstetrics & Gynaecology-II, Stomatology, Ophthalmology , Otorhinolarygology, Nuclear Medicine, Surgery-III, Emergency Medicine, Medical Technic Training before Clinical Internship.Duration 6 yearsInternship The institutions shall meticulously organize the reasonable arrangement of the internship. The duration of the internship is one year (at least 48 weeks).Degree Awarded After graduation, students will be awarded Bachelor Degree of MBBS by Anhui Medical UniversityFuture CareerA MBBS degree holder can find jobs in government as well as private hospitals, nursing homes and other health facilities.

duration.text: The MBBS at Anhui Medical University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. High School Graduation Certificate2. High School transcripts3. Foreigner Physical Examination Form4. Scanned copy of Passport (photo page and latest Chinese Visa if applicable)

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must have a good command of English. All the courses are taught in English. Applicants’ mother tongue or second language must be English, or they should have learned courses in English. They should be skillful in English listening, speaking, reading and writing.2. Applicants must be high school graduates. They must have passed English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology graduation exams. Their physics, chemistry and biology exam results must be above average.3. Applicants can’t have any adverse record. Applicants must submit their graduation certificate, exam result sheet, passport and identity card. Applicants must be between 18 and 30 years old. Applicants under 18 must submit letter of authorization for guardianship.4. Applicants must be healthy and have passed health check-up.5. Applicants must have sufficient financial support for all the fees of MBBS major.
